title: Intapp collaborates with OpenAI to deliver a governed DealCloud with Celeste plug-in to financial services
summary: Intapp announced its DealCloud with Celeste plug-in for ChatGPT for Financial Services.
body_markdown:
*Deal teams can now reach their firm’s own client, deal, and relationship record from ChatGPT through the DealCloud with Celeste plug-in, governed by Intapp*


**NEW YORK — September 10, 2026** — Intapp (NASDAQ: INTA), the governed AI platform for professional firms in highly regulated industries, announced its DealCloud with Celeste plug-in for ChatGPT for Financial Services. Celeste is Intapp’s Firm AI expert co-worker that knows the firm: its clients, its funds and investors, and the judgment calls partners have made over the years. ChatGPT for Financial Services is a tailored ChatGPT experience that combines built-in financial data with GPT-6 Astra’s reasoning to help teams develop research, financial models, and client materials in their firm’s formats.


Thousands of firms run their business on Intapp, roughly[1,700 of them in private capital and investment banking](https://www.intapp.com/clients/) . That is the foundation Firm AI arrives with – deal, investor, and relationship history already structured and governed at scale, across the firms that shape the market. Intapp has spent more than a decade building that understanding into DealCloud. Now with Celeste, it’s available in ChatGPT for Financial Services.


**What makes this possible**


With the DealCloud with Celeste plug-in for ChatGPT for Financial Services, professionals can:


- Walk into any meeting carrying the firm’s entire history with that relationship, not just their own.
- Find the shortest path to a decision, through the colleagues who already hold the relationship.
- Know where every live deal stands and what it needs next, without chasing it down.


**Why only Intapp can do this**


A firm can only put its knowledge in front of a model if what’s confidential stays confidential. Intapp has spent two decades enforcing material non-public information, information barriers, and independence obligations – long before frontier models made any of this a live question. The firm sets those rules once, inside Intapp, and they hold wherever its knowledge goes next. Today, that includes ChatGPT for Financial Services.


**Availability**


The DealCloud with Celeste plug-in is available in ChatGPT for Financial Services to eligible Intapp clients beginning today.


**Supporting quotes**


**Thad Jampol, Co-founder and Chief Product Officer, Intapp**
“Frontier models know the world. But they don’t know your firm: who you cover, what you’ve committed to, what your people are and aren’t permitted to see. Intapp built Celeste to be that intelligence, and we’re proud to bring this plug-in into ChatGPT for Financial Services for the world’s leading financial firms. Everything else in this market can be bought. What a firm knows cannot.”
